name: wrap-with-original
query: [{:id 1 :name "a"}] | map ~(:item it | get {:key /id :record ~(item)})

name: a-name-is-declared-once-in-a-scope
query: :k 1 | :k 2 | k !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-second-declaration-is-the-fault
query: :k 1 | :k 2 | k !| get /trail/0/step

name: the-fail-track-declares-in-the-same-scope
query: :x 1 | {:k 1} | raise !| :x 2 !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-recipe-declares-no-input-of-its-word-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(:x 3 | add x)) | 1 | m 2 !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-recipe-of-one-step-declares-no-input-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(:x 3)) | 1 | m 2 !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-recipe-declares-no-args-of-its-call-again
query: :number/m ~(:args 5 | add args) | 1 | m !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-group-in-a-recipe-shadows-an-input-as-any-scope-of-its-own
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~((:x 3 | x) | add x)) | 1 | m 2

name: a-recipe-declares-a-name-its-call-binds-not
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(:y 3 | add x | add y)) | 1 | m 2

name: a-later-step-of-a-recipe-declares-no-input-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(add 1 | :x 3 | add x)) | 1 | m 2 !| get [~(type) /name]

name: the-fail-track-of-a-recipe-declares-no-input-again
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~({} | raise !| :x 3 | add x)) | 1 | m 2 !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-recipe-declares-no-input-its-call-leaves-to-the-default
query: :number/plus (::fn | takes :by |~~ The by. ~~| ~(query /0 1) | impl ~(:by 3 | add by)) | 5 | plus !| get [~(type) /name]

name: a-quote-a-recipe-runs-declares-an-input-in-its-own-scope
query: :vec/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~(map ~(:x 3 | add x))) | [1 2] | m 5

name: a-recipe-of-one-group-declares-an-input-in-the-group-s-scope
query: :number/m (::fn | takes :x |~~ The x. ~~| /0 | impl ~((:x 3))) | 1 | m 2

name: a-helper-in-a-group-closes-with-it
query: :f (:h 2 | ~(mul h)) | env | has :h

name: a-recipe-names-a-value-derived-from-an-input
query: :vec/m (::fn | takes :k |~~ The k. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(:limit (k | mul 2) | take limit)) | [1 2 3 4 5] | m 2

name: a-word-names-its-subject-by-a-declaration-of-it
query: :any/pair ~(:self it | get [~(self) ~(self)]) | 5 | pair

name: a-recipe-names-its-subject-before-a-step
query: :number/scale (::fn | takes :k |~~ The k. ~~| /0 ::number | impl ~(:self it | mul k | add self)) | 5 | scale 2

name: a-recipe-shadows-a-name-of-its-scope
query: :n 1 | :any/f (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| ~(query /0 2) ::number | impl ~(n)) | null | get [~(f) ~(n)]

name: a-name-declared-in-a-recipe-stays-inside-it
query: :number/f (::fn | takes :n |~~ The n. ~~| /0 | impl ~(n | :captured it | captured | add n)) | 0 | f 3 | env | has :captured
